name: TweetEval: Multi-Task Tweet Classification Benchmark
description: TweetEval is a multi-task benchmark for tweet classification curated by Cardiff NLP (Barbieri et al., Findings of EMNLP 2020). It unifies seven diverse Twitter NLP benchmarks under standardized train, validation, and test splits: Emotion Recognition (SemEval-2018 Task 1), Emoji Prediction (SemEval-2018 Task 2), Irony Detection (SemEval-2018 Task 3), Hate Speech Detection (SemEval-2019 Task 5), Offensive Language Identification (SemEval-2019 Task 6), Sentiment Analysis (SemEval-2017 Task 4), and Stance Detection (SemEval-2016 Task 6 across 5 targets).
